mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract_reinstatement ( reinstatement_id, policy_number, reinstatement_reason, desired_date, has_health_changed, last_paid_date, unpaid_installment_count, premium_per_installment, unpaid_premium, reinstatement_status, applied_at ) VALUES ( #{reinstatementId}, #{policyNumber}, #{reinstatementReason}, #{desiredDate}, #{hasHealthChanged}, #{lastPaidDate}, #{unpaidInstallmentCount}, #{premiumPerInstallment}, #{unpaidPremium}, #{reinstatementStatus}, #{appliedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT reinstatement_id, policy_number, reinstatement_reason, desired_date, has_health_changed, last_paid_date, unpaid_installment_count, premium_per_installment, unpaid_premium, reinstatement_status, underwriting_request_id, applied_at, unpaid_settled_at, completed_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_reinstatement WHERE reinstatement_id = #{reinstatementId}

SELECT reinstatement_id, policy_number, reinstatement_reason, desired_date, has_health_changed, last_paid_date, unpaid_installment_count, premium_per_installment, unpaid_premium, reinstatement_status, underwriting_request_id, applied_at, unpaid_settled_at, completed_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_reinstatement WHERE policy_number = #{policyNumber} AND reinstatement_status IN ('APPLIED', 'UNPAID_SETTLED') ORDER BY applied_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT reinstatement_id, policy_number, reinstatement_reason, desired_date, has_health_changed, last_paid_date, unpaid_installment_count, premium_per_installment, unpaid_premium, reinstatement_status, underwriting_request_id, applied_at, unpaid_settled_at, completed_at, cancelled_at FROM contract_reinstatement WHERE policy_number = #{policyNumber} ORDER BY applied_at DESC
